# truefoundry_ml_repo (Resource)

Manages a TrueFoundry ML repo (`ml-repo` manifest) via `PUT /api/svc/v1/ml-repos` — the blob-storage-backed container that versioned artifacts such as agent skills (`truefoundry_agent_skill`) and prompts (`truefoundry_prompt`) live in. Deleting the repo deletes the artifacts it contains. Existing repos can be imported by their name, e.g. `terraform import truefoundry_ml_repo.example my-repo`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An ML repo is the blob-storage-backed container that agent skills and
# prompts live in.
resource "truefoundry_azure_account" "storage" {
  name = "gateway-storage"

  blob_storages = [
    {
      name              = "artifacts"
      storage_root      = "https://myaccount.blob.core.windows.net/artifacts/tfy-managed-storage"
      connection_string = "tfy-secret://my-tenant:gateway-secrets:artifacts-connection-string"
    },
  ]
}

resource "truefoundry_ml_repo" "gateway_artifacts" {
  name                    = "gateway-artifacts"
  description             = "Skills and prompts of the AI gateway"
  storage_integration_fqn = "${truefoundry_azure_account.storage.fqn}:blob-storage:artifacts"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the ML repo (3-100 characters; must start with a letter, end with a letter or digit, and contain only letters, digits and hyphens — upper case is allowed here, unlike other manifest names). Changing it replaces the repo.
- `storage_integration_fqn` (String) FQN of the blob storage integration backing the repo, e.g. of a `truefoundry_azure_account` integration: my-tenant:azure:my-account:blob-storage:my-storage. Artifacts already written cannot move, so changing it replaces the repo.

### Optional

- `collaborators` (Attributes Set, Deprecated) Subjects with a role on this ML repo; use `truefoundry_role_binding` instead. Unset leaves the grants on the control plane untouched (and they are not tracked); an empty set clears them, which is only accepted until 15 Nov 2026. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--collaborators))
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of what the repo contains.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Control plane ID of the ML repo.

<a id="nestedatt--collaborators"></a>
### Nested Schema for `collaborators`

Required:

- `role_id` (String) Role to assign, e.g. mlf-project-admin, mlf-project-editor, or mlf-project-viewer.
- `subject` (String) Subject FQN, e.g. user:jane@example.com or team:everyone.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# ML repos are imported by their name.
terraform import truefoundry_ml_repo.gateway_artifacts gateway-artifacts
```
